title.rendered: Set Your Mind on the Things of the Spirit: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: The mind set on the flesh is death. The mind set on the Spirit is life and peace. What you set your mind on is not a small thing. It is everything.

content.rendered:
The mind set on the flesh is death. The mind set on the Spirit is life and peace. What you set your mind on is not a small thing. It is everything.

The Gospel For Today | Tuesday, June 2, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“Those who live according to the flesh have their minds set on what the flesh desires; but those who live in accordance with the Spirit have their minds set on what the Spirit desires. The mind governed by the flesh is death, but the mind governed by the Spirit is life and peace.”
Romans 8:5-6 (NIV)

Today’s Message

Where you set your mind is where you eventually live. Paul does not say this with poetry. He says it with the bluntness of a doctor giving a diagnosis. The mind set on the flesh produces death. The mind set on the Spirit produces life and peace. Two minds. Two directions. Two outcomes. There is no neutral middle ground.

The flesh is not just bad behaviour. The flesh is the whole orientation of the human heart that lives as if God were not real, not good, not present. Set your mind there, on the anxieties, the resentments, the comparisons, the appetites, the fears, and a strange thing begins to happen: even good moments lose their flavour. The mind set on the flesh dies a little every hour, even when nothing visibly bad has occurred. That is the diagnosis.

But the mind set on the Spirit is something else entirely. To set your mind on the Spirit is to deliberately turn your attention toward the things that are true about God and about you in Christ. The Spirit lives in me. The Father loves me. The Son intercedes for me. Nothing can separate me from this love. Every promise of God is yes and amen. My present sufferings are not worth comparing with the glory to be revealed. These are not slogans. These are oxygen.

And the result is what Paul names: life and peace. Not as a transaction. As the natural fruit of where your mind lives. A mind that camps in the truth of the Spirit becomes a mind that breathes life. A heart that breathes life finds peace settling on it like dew. You did not earn it. You simply set your mind where life and peace already live.

This is not denial of your circumstances. This is reorientation. The circumstances are real. The Spirit is more real. Set your mind on Him today, and watch the mind set on Him become a mind set free.

Prayer

Father, today I deliberately set my mind on the things of Your Spirit. I turn my attention away from the noise of the flesh and toward the steady, quiet truths of who You are and who I am in Christ. Let life and peace be the atmosphere of my thoughts today. Where I have been camping in worry, anger, or fear, lead me home to the Spirit. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

My mind is set on the Spirit, not the flesh. Today I think about what is true. Life and peace are my mental atmosphere. I am not a slave to the noise of the flesh. By the Spirit, I rule my mind, and the mind I have given to Christ becomes the mind that breathes life.
